Subject: Proposed MAP framework & close-window scenarios for Greenleaf Health

Hi Maya / Victor —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Attaching an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft to capture the milestones we discussed, along with two recommended close-window scenarios. High-level recap below and a couple of asks so we can convert this into a working playbook: 

Quick recap (discovery highlights)
- Primary objective: pilot Redwood inference to reduce inference cost for clinical summarization and speed up turnaround for provider notes.
- Key constraints: VPC-only deployment preferred, SOC 2 evidence required, procurement window in late January.
- Success criteria: sub-100ms median latency for 256-token prompts and <=30% cost/unit reduction within production run.

Attached: GLH_MAP_Draft_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners) and a one-page milestones PDF.

Proposed close-window options (pick one):
A) Accelerated (4–5 weeks): immediate kick, parallel SE work + procurement. Target close: 2027-01-14.
B) Standard (6–8 weeks): allow legal procurement cadence; target close: 2027-01-28.

Milestones (high-level) — owners are provisional and editable in the sheet:
- Kickoff & architecture review (owner: Aditya) — week 0
- Security questionnaire & SOC 2 scoping (owner: Maya / Greenleaf legal) — week 1–2
- VPC peering / network baseline (owner: Greenleaf infra) — week 2
- Pilot data onboarding & benchmarking (owner: Laura) — week 3
- Sign-off & handover to CS (owner: Greenleaf PM + Redwood CS) — week 4–6

Asks:
1) Confirm which close-window option you prefer (A or B).
2) Confirm the internal stakeholder roster we should include on the MAP (technical owner, procurement lead, legal reviewer, product/PM).
3) Any dependencies we should record (e.g., external approvals, specific compliance evidence, calendar freeze weeks)?

If it helps, I can propose a short 30-min follow-up early next week to finalize owners and lock a target close date.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

--
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and the draft. Appreciate how you laid out the two close-window options. A few notes from our side: 

- We prefer option B (Standard, 6–8 weeks) given holiday coverage in mid-January and our legal queue. Target close: 2027-01-28.
- Stakeholders:
  * Technical owner: Victor Chen (Infra) — victor.chen@greenleafhealth.com
  * Procurement lead: myself (Maya Patel) — I own contracts for pilot pilots like this
  * Legal reviewer: Jamie Liu (j.liu@greenleafhealth.com) — will be looped once the redline is ready
  * Product/PM: Priya Singh (cc not on this thread yet) — I'll add her in the next update

Dependencies to call out:
- We need a SOC 2 SSF scoping note (our InfoSec will validate), and an estimate of data residency (we require US region).
- VPC peering should be scheduled only after we validate the CIDR plan with our network team.

I can do a 30-min sync on Tuesday morning (US/PST) to confirm owners and finalize the MAP. Please send 2–3 time options.

Best,

Hi all —

Quick technical clarifications and suggested ownership tweaks based on discovery: 

- VPC peering & networking: Victor to own scheduling with their network team. Redwoods SEs (Aditya) will provide a CIDR checklist and a short runbook. Estimated prep effort: ~4–8 hours.
- SOC 2 evidence: Laura / Redwood security will provide the standard artifact bundle (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagrams). We should put a conditional milestone: "SOC 2 scoping call complete" before pilot onboarding.
- Pilot data onboarding: Recommend a staged approach — synthetic + small production slice. Ownership: Laura (Redwood CS) + Greenleaf data lead.
- Milestone owner suggestion: make "Sign-off & handover" a joint item owned by Greenleaf PM + Redwood CS with explicit acceptance criteria (latency, cost delta, privacy checks).

Also: small ask — can Greenleaf confirm whether the pilot will use an anonymized dataset or live PHI? That affects our audit/scope and the timeline.

I'll add these notes into the MAP spreadsheet and re-upload a v1.1 with owner columns filled in.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
